scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile infra up -d --wait
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile infra down
scripts.full:up: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile full up -d --build --wait
scripts.full:down: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile full down
